subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Persuade
solution:
The correct answer is: Halt

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Persuade **means to make someone do or believe something by giving them a good reason to do it.

 
 
• Example -* It was difficult to **persuade **Leela to change her mind.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Halt means to stop someone from moving or doing something or happening.
 
 
• Example -* An accident **halted **the traffic in the town centre for half an hour.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Persuade**' and 'Halt' are opposite in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 1.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Lead **means to guide someone to a place, especially by going in front.
 
• **Coax **means to attempt to influence by gentle persuasion, flattery, etc.
 
• **Sway **means to influence somebody.
